{"path": "kova.js", "content": "class TokenBucket {
  /**
   * @param {{capacity: number, refillPerSecond: number, now?: function(): number}} config
   */
  constructor(config) {
    const { capacity, refillPerSecond, now } = config;

    // 1. RangeError Validation
    if (typeof capacity !== 'number' || capacity <= 0 || !isFinite(capacity)) {
      throw new RangeError("Capacity must be a positive finite number.");
    }
    if (typeof refillPerSecond !== 'number' || refillPerSecond < 0 || !isFinite(refillPerSecond)) {
      throw new RangeError("Refill per second must be a non-negative finite number.");
    }

    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.refillPerSecond = refillPerSecond;
    this.nowRef = now || Date.now;
    
    // Initial state: full bucket, set last refill time to current time
    this.tokens = capacity;
    this.lastRefillTime = this.nowRef();
  }

  /**
   * Updates the token count based on elapsed time since the last update.
   * Handles time reversal (no change if time goes backward).
   */
  _refill() {
    const currentTime = this.nowRef();
    const elapsedTime = currentTime - this.lastRefillTime;

    if (elapsedTime > 0) {
      // Calculate tokens added: (elapsed_seconds) * refillRate
      const secondsElapsed = elapsedTime / 1000;
      const tokensToAdd = secondsElapsed * this.refillPerSecond;

      this.tokens = Math.min(this.capacity, this.tokens + tokensToAdd);
      this.lastRefillTime = currentTime;
    }
    // If elapsedTime <= 0, no change is applied (time went backward or is the same).
  }

  /**
   * Checks if n tokens can be taken and consumes them if available.
   * @param {number} n - Tokens to take (default 1).
   * @returns {boolean} True if successful, false otherwise.
   */
  tryTake(n = 1) {
    // 2. RangeError Validation for n
    if (typeof n !== 'number' || n <= 0 || !isFinite(n)) {
      throw new RangeError("Tokens to take (n) must be a positive finite number.");
    }
    
    this._refill();

    if (this.tokens >= n) {
      this.tokens -= n;
      return true;
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns the current available token count (can be fractional).
   * @returns {number} Current tokens.
   */
  available() {
    this._refill();
    return this.tokens;
  }

  /**
   * Calculates milliseconds until n tokens are available.
   * @param {number} n - Tokens needed (default 1).
   * @returns {number} Milliseconds until available (ceiling integer), 0 if available now, Infinity otherwise.
   */
  msUntil(n = 1) {
    // 2. RangeError Validation for n
    if (typeof n !== 'number' || n <= 0 || !isFinite(n)) {
      throw new RangeError("Tokens needed (n) must be a positive finite number.");
    }

    this._refill();

    if (this.tokens >= n) {
      return 0; // Available now
    }

    // Edge case: If refill rate is 0 or needed tokens exceed capacity, it's impossible.
    if (this.refillPerSecond <= 0 || n > this.capacity) {
      return Infinity;
    }

    // Tokens still needed
    const needed = n - this.tokens;
    // Time needed in seconds = needed / refillRate
    const secondsNeeded = needed / this.refillPerSecond;
    // Time needed in ms
    const msNeeded = secondsNeeded * 1000;

    // Return rounded up integer milliseconds
    return Math.ceil(msNeeded);
  }
}

module.exports = { TokenBucket };
